description: Code Engine serverless functions (code, not container images). action runtimes lists the valid runtime ids and needs no project. Identify a function with project_id and function_name. Call get_schema with name ce_function for every action's fields.

action.description: runtimes: List available runtimes (no project needed). | list: List functions. Needs project_id. | get: Get one function, including its URL. Needs project_id, function_name. | create: Create a function from code_reference (inline data: URL or a registry image). Needs project_id, function_name, runtime, code_reference. | update: Change code, runtime, scaling, or env. Needs project_id, function_name. | delete: Delete a function. Needs project_id, function_name.

code_reference.description: Inline code as a data URL or reference to a code bundle image

function_name.description: Function name, from ce_function action list.

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

region.description: CE region (e.g. us-south). Defaults to us-south.

runtime.description: Runtime identifier (e.g. nodejs-20). Use ce_function with action runtimes.

name: ce_function
